1. to be of opinion, suppose: , , ; c. inf., , , , , , , , ; c. acc et inf., , ; seq. ὅτι, , , , , , , , , .
2. to seem, be reputed: ; c. inf., , , , , , , , ; οἱ δοκοῦντες, those of repute, . Impers., it seems, c. dat. pers.;
(a) to think: , , , ;
(b) to please, seem good to: c. inf., , , , , .†
SYN. (δοκέω 1.): ἡγέομαι 2, νομίζω2, οἴομαι; ἡ. and ν. properly express belief resting on external proof, ἡ. denoting the more careful judgment; δ. and οἴ. imply a subjective judgment which in the case of οἴ. is based on feeling, in δ. on thought (v. Schmidt, c. 17)
